observations: Identity: the runtime did not give me a task or agent ID. reviewer.task is null; the parent must fill it from the Agent tool result and must not invent one.

What I read: AGENTS.md (from the system context), docs/REVISION-AND-REVIEWS.md, docs/NARRATIVE-FLOW.md, docs/PROMPTS.md, source/original.txt and this whole request. I opened workflow/review/page-01.png with Read and looked at it; it was readable. I did not open the storyboards, the separate panel PNGs or the cast sheets listed in files[].

Every text matches the approved script word for word. 01-1 caption: 'A busy day at Dr. Ananya's clinic.' 01-2 balloons: 'Appointments, patient details, follow-ups...' and 'I wish everything were easier to manage!' 01-3 balloon: 'Our time belongs with patients. Let's make the rest simpler.' The page shows apostrophes as typographic marks, which is only a typeface difference.
01-1: the caption sits in the top-left over the wall and awning. It does not touch Ananya's face or her open gesturing hand.

01-2: both tails end at Meera's head. The second, shorter balloon sits right of and lower than the first, so it reads as her continuing thought. The phone receiver, the pen hand, the register and the stack are all clear of the lettering.
01-3: the tail ends at Ananya's head beside her hand at her chin. The balloon is in empty wall space and does not cover the small background Meera.
The first reading raised no concerns that needed fixing. Its note that one speaker has two balloons in 01-2 is confirmed and is acceptable.
I read the page left to right and top to bottom, as the source's Western order requires: caption, then 01-2 top-left balloon, then 01-2 lower-right balloon, then the 01-3 balloon.
The 01-2 lower-right balloon is closer to the 01-3 balloon than to the first 01-2 balloon, but the panel gutter and the tail down to Meera keep it inside 01-2. I did not jump ahead to Ananya.

transitions.observation: The 01-1 background shows the reception desk with a phone and registers. 01-2 cuts inside to that same busy desk on the same morning, now with Meera and the queue.
01-3 puts Meera, still on the phone and writing, in the background of Ananya's panel. Ananya's line clearly answers Meera's wish.
Time skip. The sunset window, the office laptop and the caption 'The clinic begins its Welbuk onboarding.' show this is later, and they answer Ananya's resolve to 'make the rest simpler'.

readingReview.comparison: My reading matches the first reading's order exactly. The first reading had no outstanding concerns, and nothing has changed.
